title: Ars Inquirendi 2026: models, datasets, tools, methods and papers named by participants
sources: arsinq.com programme and abstracts (public, read 20 Nov 2026); linked slides, papers and repositories; Graphosphere I recordings (machine transcripts); Meelen keynote notes. Compiled by three Sonnet research agents; URLs checked by web search, not by a person.
fields: type: skill|model|dataset|archive|tool|method|paper|benchmark; open: open|partly|closed|unknown; confidence: verified|likely|not found (applies to the identification and URL)

items.name: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern
items.what: A pattern for a personal knowledge base of markdown files that an LLM ingests, queries and lints, published as a gist by Andrej Karpathy in April 2026.

mentions.use: Grant builds a curated source system on this pattern and demonstrates it in the workshop.

items.name: Codex (OpenAI)
items.what: OpenAI's coding agent, used as an LLM harness over local files.

mentions.use: Grant's slides show Codex completion reports and correction records from his legal-scholarship projects.
Rabus cites it alongside Claude Code as a commercial coding agent.

items.role: coding agent harness over local files

items.name: Grant, Using LLMs in Scholarship (slides)
items.what: 136-page slide deck on prompts, context management, harnesses and a Karpathy-style source wiki.

mentions.use: Course material for the workshop.

items.role: workshop slides on prompts and harnesses

items.name: Whisper
items.what: OpenAI's open speech-recognition model.

mentions.use: Meelen fine-tuned it on performed Tibetan rituals; it took 14 days and she judged data and compute too thin to post-train it further.

items.name: Wav2Vec2
items.what: Facebook's self-supervised speech representation model.

mentions.use: Meelen uses it for ritual speech recognition, as a smaller model than Whisper.

items.name: MMS (Massively Multilingual Speech)
items.what: Meta's multilingual speech recognition models.

mentions.use: Meelen names it with Wav2Vec2 as a smaller option for ritual speech.

items.name: KenLM
items.what: A fast n-gram language-model toolkit.

mentions.use: Meelen adds a small KenLM model to speech recognition and to Tibetan normalisation.

items.role: n-gram LM for ASR and normalisation

items.name: Transkribus (platform; PaganTibet Ume models trained in it)
items.what: Commercial handwriting-recognition platform; Meelen's PaganTibet Ume models are trained and shared in it (PT-Ume7: 3.71% character error).
items.licence: not stated here (JOHD article is open access)

mentions.use: First stage of Meelen's pipeline; the models were trained on triple-checked transcriptions.
Expected Rabus comparator; not named in the Sunday abstract.

items.name: Meelen & Griffiths 2026, Revue d'Études Tibétaines 84 (PT-Ume7 and HTR benchmarking)
items.what: Reports the Ume HTR models and shows models from other projects failing on her manuscripts.

mentions.use: The checked figures behind the keynote's HTR claims.

items.role: reports Ume HTR models, cross-project failures

items.name: Meelen & Griffiths 2025, HTR for Tibetan manuscripts (JOHD)
items.what: Open data paper with Transkribus models, code and ground truth for Tibetan manuscripts.

mentions.use: Describes the three-tier annotator checking and agreement figures cited in the keynote.

items.role: HTR data paper with ground-truth checking

items.name: PaganTibet HTR Input & Correction Manual
items.what: Manual for transcribing and correcting Tibetan Ume manuscripts.

mentions.use: Instructions for the monks and annotators in Meelen's project.

items.role: transcription and correction manual for annotators

items.name: Tibetan normalisation pipeline (rules, seq2seq, KenLM) and gold test data
items.what: Rule-based, seq2seq and KenLM-based normalisation of diplomatic Tibetan, with data augmented from about 10,000 pairs to over a million.

mentions.use: Step 6 of Meelen's pipeline; her published repo reports rules alone beating neural variants.

items.name: Tibetan-normalisation-testdata
items.what: 217 PaganTibet lines, diplomatic to standard.

mentions.use: Public test set for the normalisation work.

items.name: Huang et al. 2023, transformer standardiser for Scottish Gaelic
items.what: Transformer system that standardises historical Gaelic orthography, trained on augmented data.

mentions.use: The inspiration Meelen cites for augmenting her Tibetan data.

items.name: Griffiths & Meelen 2025, How 'Pagan' Is My Text?
items.what: Pipeline from HTR through normalisation to embedding-based classification of Buddhist, Bon and Pagan texts.

mentions.use: Basis of the keynote's content-catalogue method (embeddings plus classifier).

items.name: Meelen, Nehrdich & Keutzer 2024, Breakthroughs in Tibetan NLP and Digital Humanities
items.what: Survey of Tibetan NLP, in Revue d'Études Tibétaines 72.

mentions.use: Field overview underpinning the keynote.

items.name: ACTib 2.0
items.what: 185-million-token tagged corpus of Classical Tibetan.

items.name: AnandaSky

items.what: VICReg self-supervised learning adapted to learn handwriting representations without writer labels.
